evidence.quote: Have a histological diagnosis of metastatic or locally advanced inoperable NET, NEC, or other solid tumors that have confirmed radiological progression.
Have a tumor that expresses SSR confirmed by SSR imaging.
Have an ECOG performance status of 0, 1, or 2.

evidence.quote: Participant has documented HIV infection by any licensed assay or documented history of detectable HIV-1 RNA.

labels.note: Transplant study for people with HIV receiving HIV-positive donor livers; he has no HIV and no transplant plan.

evidence.quote: Male and female subjects with advanced unresectable, recurrent or metastatic tumors who have received standard of care (SOC) therapy for their advanced/metastatic tumors and have no other SOC therapy available.
Have measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1.

labels.note: Further standard HCC options remain after atezolizumab/bevacizumab and lenvatinib (e.g. cabozantinib, regorafenib).

Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) score of 0 or 1

evidence.quote: PATIENTS: Starting a new course of an oral anti-cancer agent (the list of agents is posted to the CTSU website) other than sex hormone inhibitors, within 4 weeks after registration or have started an oral anti-cancer agent in the past 8 weeks.

labels.note: Escalation part open to progressing solid tumors; HCV cured. Platelet count ('mildly low') and bilirubin unknown with cirrhosis.
